mapper.select: SELECT s.id AS stud_id, s.first_name, s.last_name, s.midterm_grade, s.final_grade, d.id AS dept_id, d.name, d.display_name FROM student s LEFT JOIN departments d ON s.department_id = d.id WHERE s.id = #{id}
SELECT s.id AS stud_id, s.first_name, s.last_name, s.midterm_grade, s.final_grade, d.id AS dept_id, d.name, d.display_name FROM student s LEFT JOIN departments d ON s.department_id = d.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO student (first_name, last_name, midterm_grade, final_grade) VALUES (#{firstName}, #{lastName}, #{midtermGrade}, #{finalGrade})
mapper.update: UPDATE student SET first_name = #{firstName}, last_name = #{lastName}, midterm_grade = #{midtermGrade}, final_grade = #{finalGrade} WHERE id = #{id}
